data.title: Inventory requests are timing out intermittently
data.customer_impact: Checkout completion rate is below the 99% service objective; customer-facing errors are active.
data.operator_note: A dashboard note suggests a recent traffic increase may be involved.
data.objective: Restore checkout success >=99%, p95 <=800ms, and critical services to healthy state.

payload.hypothesis: The intermittent timeouts are caused by a transient spike in inventory-service CPU usage leading to request queuing, not by a persistent configuration issue.

steps.objective: Verify CPU and memory utilization of inventory-service during timeout windows
steps.success_signal: CPU usage > 85% and memory > 80% during at least one timeout event

steps.objective: Check request queue length and latency metrics for inventory-service
steps.success_signal: Queue length > 50 requests and p95 latency > 800ms during timeout events

steps.objective: Confirm that other services (order-service, payment-service) maintain normal metrics
steps.success_signal: All other services show CPU < 70%, memory < 70%, and p95 latency < 500ms

steps.objective: Apply a temporary autoscaling rule to increase inventory-service replicas during peak traffic
steps.success_signal: Replica count increases to 3 within 2 minutes and p95 latency drops below 800ms

steps.objective: Validate checkout success rate returns to ≥99% and no new timeouts occur for 30 minutes
steps.success_signal: Checkout success rate ≥99% and zero timeout errors logged
